sources.title: Talk of Champions: What exactly is giving folks pause about Ole Miss?
sources.text: Earlier this week, CBS Sports’ co-host and Game Runs Deep ‘s Sudu Upadhyay joined Talk of Champions to discuss the 2026 Ole Miss Rebels . I wrote a piece earlier this week – trying to find the main reasons for concern this season with the Rebels. It was tough but I found five things Pete Golding and Co., need to go right for major success this year. Upadhyay tries to help me figure out why there’s so much national pause from the talking heads. We also discuss the NFL-to-CFB pipeline in Baton Rouge.
